response.text:
I hear you, but I still need one clear detail before I can send: **which payment?**

Your message says "secure the room," which sounds like rent to your landlord — but the invoice we were looking at is tuition to the university. These are two different payees and amounts, and I can't guess.

Please reply with one of these:

- **"Pay AUD 6,500 to Harbourview University"** (the tuition invoice), or
- **"Pay AUD [amount] to Mr. Chen"** (the room/rent) — tell me the amount.

Once you confirm the payee and amount, I'll send it immediately.
